key_insight: Contrastive Discovery helps scientific agents identify which competing explanation evidence supports, rather than merely reject a single hypothesis.
engineering_relevance: Existing discovery agents can adopt contrast sets to reinterpret collected evidence or guide experiments without increasing the experiment budget.
method: Pair each scientific question with mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive explanations.
Score experiments by how evidence redistributes belief across those explanations.
Resolve a question when belief concentrates on one explanation.
evidence_signal: Across six domains, contrast sets resolved 73% of high-belief-shift pointwise rejections to specific alternatives; guided search resolved 67% more questions, while 38 blinded experts agreed with 78% of resolved answers.
watch_item: Results depend on constructing genuinely exhaustive, nonoverlapping explanation sets; omitted alternatives could produce misleading confidence.
paper_title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
